title: SelfHeal IT — Frontend guided troubleshooting, sessions, and history

requirements.summary: Add Internet Identity sign-in gating and user profile flow; use authenticated principal for all session/history UI queries.
acceptanceCriteria: A signed-out user is prompted to sign in with Internet Identity before creating or viewing troubleshooting sessions.
Troubleshooting sessions created after sign-in are associated with the caller principal in the backend.
A user can only view their own troubleshooting history.

file_operations.description: Create the top-level app shell and routing with an authentication gate: when signed out, show a sign-in prompt; when signed in, render the Start/Intake, Session Detail, and History views. Use the selected authorization component guidance to enforce ‘must be logged in before seeing any application data’. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add a Login/Logout button using the existing useInternetIdentity hook and clear React Query cache on logout per the selected authorization component guidance. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Implement first-login profile setup (ask for user name, call getCallerUserProfile/saveCallerUserProfile). Use the selected authorization component guidance to avoid profile-setup modal flash (actor-dependent query state). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add an AuthGate wrapper that blocks access to any session/history UI when identity is missing, and shows an English sign-in call-to-action with LoginButton. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add a user-friendly screen for handling authorization failures returned by backend traps (e.g., attempting to load someone else’s session), consistent with the selected authorization component error-handling guidance. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Create a guided Issue Intake flow (category + questionnaire) to start a new troubleshooting session and navigate to session detail.
acceptanceCriteria: The user can start a new troubleshooting session from the home screen.
The intake flow captures: category, a short title, symptom selections, and optional free-text notes.
Submitting the intake creates a new session and navigates to a session detail view.

file_operations.description: Implement the Start/Issue Intake screen: category picker, title input, symptom questionnaire per category, and notes field; on submit choose a recommended runbook and call backend startSession(issueDescription, runbookId), then navigate to Session Detail. Compose UI with shadcn-ui components (do not edit frontend/src/components/ui). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create a category selection component (uses generated category icons sprite) that feeds the intake flow. Compose UI with shadcn-ui components (do not edit frontend/src/components/ui). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create a reusable symptom selection UI that adapts questions/choices by category and returns selected symptoms for runbook recommendation. Compose UI with shadcn-ui components (do not edit frontend/src/components/ui). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add frontend-only logic to map intake category/symptoms to the best runbook id (deterministic scoring) to pass into startSession.
Wire the Start/Issue Intake page into the app routing and navigation (no orphan pages).

requirements.summary: Provide a built-in runbook catalog (18+ runbooks) and show the recommended runbook step-by-step in session detail.
acceptanceCriteria: At least 6 categories are available with at least 3 issues/runbooks per category (minimum 18 runbooks total).
Each runbook is composed of ordered steps with: title, instruction text, and an expected user action (e.g., confirm/yes-no/mark-done).
The session detail view displays the recommended runbook based on the selected category/symptoms and allows the user to proceed step-by-step.

file_operations.description: Define a built-in runbook catalog with at least 6 categories and at least 18 total runbooks (>=3 per category), including ordered steps and expected user actions; keep all user-facing text in English.

Implement session detail view: load session via backend getSession, display runbook title/steps, and provide step-by-step progression UI reflecting currentStep and results; show decision points when present. Compose UI with shadcn-ui components (do not edit frontend/src/components/ui). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create a stepper component that renders ordered troubleshooting steps, highlights current step, and displays prior step outcomes from the session timeline. Compose UI with shadcn-ui components (do not edit frontend/src/components/ui). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add helpers for presenting runbook steps and step results in a consistent, readable timeline (timestamps, labels, outcome text).
Register and wire the Session Detail route (e.g., using a sessionId route param) so intake and history can navigate to it.

requirements.summary: Support safe, simulated “Quick Actions” (copyable commands/instructions) and record attempted outcomes.
acceptanceCriteria: Steps can include an optional “Quick Action” button that (a) copies a command/snippet or (b) reveals concise instructions, and (c) records that the user attempted it.
The UI clearly labels quick actions as guided/simulated (no device changes are executed by the app).

file_operations.description: Add a Quick Action UI for applicable steps: copy-to-clipboard for commands/snippets and/or reveal instructions, clearly labeled as simulated/guided; when used, record an attempt by calling backend completeStep with an outcome string. Compose UI with shadcn-ui components (do not edit frontend/src/components/ui). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add a small clipboard utility (copy text + fallback messaging) used by Quick Actions and escalation summary copy.
Integrate QuickActionPanel into the step UI, ensuring outcomes are recorded and reflected in the timeline after refresh.

requirements.summary: Enable marking sessions resolved or escalated; generate and copy an incident summary; lock edits when resolved.
acceptanceCriteria: A session can be marked Resolved, which locks step editing and records a resolution timestamp.
A session can be marked Escalated and produces a copyable summary text block.
The summary includes: category, title, symptoms, notes, and a chronological list of steps + outcomes.

file_operations.description: Create action controls to mark Resolved (call backend markResolved) or Escalated (call backend escalate then fetch getSessionEscalationSummary); include a copy button for the summary and ensure all text is in English. Compose UI with shadcn-ui components (do not edit frontend/src/components/ui). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Wire in SessionOutcomeActions; when status is resolved, lock step editing/recording UI (read-only mode) and present resolution info (based on session status/updated timestamps).

requirements.summary: Create a History view with search/filter for the current user’s sessions and read-only timeline review.
acceptanceCriteria: The history list loads the current user’s sessions from the backend.
Users can filter by status and category and search by title/notes.
Selecting a session opens a read-only timeline of steps and results.

file_operations.description: Implement history list UI that loads sessions from backend for the signed-in principal, supports filter by status/category and search by title/notes, and navigates to Session Detail in read-only review mode. Compose UI with shadcn-ui components (do not edit frontend/src/components/ui). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create reusable filter/search controls for status and category plus text search. Compose UI with shadcn-ui components (do not edit frontend/src/components/ui). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add React Query hooks for loading sessions and session details via the actor (using useActor + identity), handling unauthorized errors by surfacing AccessDeniedScreen.
Register and wire the History route into routing and navigation so it is reachable from the app shell.

requirements.summary: Apply a consistent IT-support visual theme and English-only UI text across Start/Intake, Session Detail, and History.
acceptanceCriteria: All visible UI text is in English.
The app uses a consistent theme (e.g., neutral/slate + accent color) across navigation, cards, buttons, and forms without mixing styles.
Key screens (Start/Intake, Session Detail, History) share consistent layout and components.

file_operations.description: Create global styles and Tailwind layer configuration for a cohesive IT-support theme (neutral/slate base + single accent), consistent typography and spacing, and readable defaults; ensure all user-facing strings remain English.
Adjust/extend theme tokens (colors/radius/shadows if needed) to support the consistent IT-support look while keeping configuration aligned with existing Tailwind + shadcn-ui setup.

Create a shared layout (header + main container) used by Start/Intake, Session Detail, and History for consistent structure; compose with shadcn-ui components (do not edit frontend/src/components/ui). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create a consistent header with generated logo, navigation links (Start, History), and LoginButton/user name display from profile. Compose UI with shadcn-ui components (do not edit frontend/src/components/ui). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Wrap routed pages in AppLayout and ensure consistent navigation and tone across key screens.

requirements.summary: Add required generated static images under frontend/public/assets/generated and render them in header, landing/start hero, and category selection UI.
acceptanceCriteria: Generated images exist under frontend/public/assets/generated and are referenced directly by the frontend.
The app displays a logo in the header and a hero/illustration on the landing/start screen.
Category icons are used in the issue category selection UI.

file_operations.description: Add the generated static image asset at frontend/public/assets/generated/selfheal-logo.dim_512x512.png (served directly by the frontend; not fetched via backend).
Add the generated static image asset at frontend/public/assets/generated/it-support-hero.dim_1600x900.png (served directly by the frontend; not fetched via backend).
Add the generated static image asset at frontend/public/assets/generated/category-icons-sprite.dim_1024x1024.png (served directly by the frontend; not fetched via backend).
Render the header logo using frontend/public/assets/generated/selfheal-logo.dim_512x512.png and keep sizing/alt text consistent with the app theme.
Render the landing/start hero illustration using frontend/public/assets/generated/it-support-hero.dim_1600x900.png and incorporate it into the existing Start/Intake screen (no extra top-level pages).
Use the category icons sprite frontend/public/assets/generated/category-icons-sprite.dim_1024x1024.png to visually represent categories in the selection UI.
